metadata.coverage_boundary: Selected task forms, chiefly Catalyst 9300 IOS XE 17.15.x; separately scoped router and legacy IOS references

task_workflows.title: Configure an access port in VLAN 20
intent_aliases: make Gi1/0/10 an access port in VLAN 20
put a PC port in VLAN 20
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Port is an endpoint port, not an uplink or channel member.
Capture existing interface/VLAN settings and upstream VLAN reachability.
expected_results: Operational access mode and VLAN 20; expected link and STP forwarding.

instructions: Restore captured access VLAN and mode.
Delete VLAN 20 only if newly created and unused elsewhere; default interface is not a routine rollback.

task_workflows.title: Add VLAN 20 to a trunk
intent_aliases: allow vlan 20 on an existing uplink
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary

expected_results: VLAN 20 allowed, active and forwarding where intended.

instructions: Remove VLAN 20 from the allowed list only if absent before this change.
Restore any separately changed native VLAN/mode from captured state.

task_workflows.title: Locate an endpoint MAC address
intent_aliases: which switch port is a MAC on
what is connected to this port
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Correct VLAN/context; endpoint has recently sent traffic.
expected_results: Learned port and VLAN located; an uplink can require repeating lookup on the next switch.

decision_branches.action: Check VLAN, recent endpoint traffic, aging and port security; do not invent a location.
Follow the topology and repeat on the downstream switch; table alone does not identify a human/device owner.

task_workflows.title: Investigate interface errors and drops
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Capture time interval and offered traffic; hardware queue/FED counters may require the next research partition.
expected_results: Compare two timestamped samples; classify error growth versus congestion/drop symptoms.

decision_branches.action: Do not diagnose an ongoing fault from the total alone.
Collect platform queue/policer evidence before asserting a physical fault.

instructions: No automatic counter clearing, port bounce or duplex/MTU changes.

task_workflows.title: Enable OSPFv2 on a routed link
task_workflows.platform_boundary: IOS XE 17.x router configuration guide plus Catalyst 9300 17.15.x verification evidence; exact router hardware must be qualified
prerequisites: IP addressing and routing already working.
Unique router IDs, area, timers, authentication, MTU and network type checked at both ends.
Configure both endpoints separately; process IDs are locally significant.
expected_results: Expected adjacency and approved OSPF routes.

instructions: Remove only the newly added interface OSPF attachment; restore prior settings.
Remove process 10 only if newly created and unused by other interfaces.

task_workflows.title: Diagnose OSPF adjacency failure
intent_aliases: OSPF neighbors will not become adjacent
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Collect both peers and intended network topology.
expected_results: Identify state-specific evidence before changing timers, authentication or MTU.

decision_branches.action: Check link/IP, OSPF interface attachment, passive policy, area, authentication and packet reachability.
Can be normal; compare DR/BDR roles and intended topology.
Compare MTU and DBD exchange; mismatch is common but not the only cause.
Inspect LSDB and RIB selection; adjacency alone does not establish end-to-end routing.

instructions: No automatic clear process, debug, or mtu-ignore workaround.

task_workflows.title: Verify an IPv4 BGP peer
task_workflows.platform_boundary: IOS XE 17.x routing guide; base IPv4 unicast form only, not all BGP address families
prerequisites: Peer address and address family known; check correct VRF separately.
expected_results: Expected session state, capabilities and received/advertised prefixes.

decision_branches.action: Session is established; zero prefixes still requires policy/address-family investigation.
Review peer reachability, TCP 179 filtering, AS numbers, source, authentication and TTL policy.

decision_branches.condition: Best BGP path missing from RIB
decision_branches.action: Review next-hop resolution and competing route selection.

instructions: Do not hard-reset BGP as a first diagnostic.

task_workflows.title: Create a named extended IPv4 ACL
intent_aliases: create an extended ACL for HTTPS
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Illustrative lab policy only; define all required flows including management and routing first.
No existing ACL/interface binding is overwritten without a captured recovery plan.
expected_results: Intended permitted traffic passes and denied traffic fails using controlled tests.

instructions: Restore the prior interface ACL binding or remove only the new binding.
Restore edited entries; delete APP_IN only if newly created and unreferenced.

task_workflows.title: Prepare SSH-only remote management
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Composite research workflow: Catalyst 9300 17.15 SSH plus separately scoped IOS/IOS XE VTY evidence; target integration untested
prerequisites: Console or independent recovery access.
Authentication/authorization already configured and tested; local-user record is optional setup, not a mandate.
Correct management VRF, route, filtering and approved crypto policy.
Composite workflow requires target qualification: VTY source is separately labeled, not assumed universal Catalyst evidence.

configuration.note: Only if a suitable key is absent; respond interactively using release-approved strength.
Example range only: repeat for every discovered VTY range.
Only on an intentionally local-authentication baseline; preserve existing AAA.

expected_results: New external SSH login succeeds at intended privilege; Telnet is rejected on all VTY ranges.

instructions: Use console/recovery path if locked out.
Restore prior AAA and VTY policy; do not zeroize established keys as generic rollback.

task_workflows.title: Configure and inspect a legacy IOS DHCP pool
intent_aliases: why are clients not getting addresses
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Legacy IOS 12.4 DHCP evidence; S08 configuration inspection syntax is separately scoped IOS XE evidence
prerequisites: IOS 12.4 documented boundary only; qualify current IOS XE separately.
No conflicting DHCP server; subnet interface or relay already provisioned.
Example addresses require an isolated lab with matching gateway/DNS.
expected_results: Client obtains a lease with intended subnet, gateway and DNS; bindings/pool agree.

instructions: Remove only newly created pool/options/exclusions; preserve prior leases and unrelated pools.

task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary

task_workflows.title: Verify an existing LACP EtherChannel
intent_aliases: why is a LACP port suspended
task_workflows.platform_boundary: Catalyst 9300 / IOS XE 17.15.x; evaluate each step source boundary
prerequisites: Identify intended members, protocol and peer configuration.
expected_results: Expected logical port-channel and bundled member flags, with compatible partner evidence.

decision_branches.action: No LACP initiator; an approved change must enable active on at least one side.
Compare VLAN, mode, speed and peer aggregation parameters before changing state.

instructions: No automatic removal/readdition of members or conversion to static on.
